subject: POC Kickoff: scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff: proposed dates + success criteria

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’re excited to kick off the POC for Acme. To get calendars aligned, can you confirm availability for a 60–75 minute kickoff the week of Sep 21? From our side I’d like to have:

- Marissa Cole (AE) — kickoff/owner
- Dylan Brooks (Solutions Eng) — technical lead
- Dev Patel (Platform SE) — implementation/infra

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Sep 24, 09:00–10:15
- Tue Sep 22, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Sep 23, 13:00–14:15

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) POC scope and timeline (15m)
3) Tech architecture & pre-reqs (20m)
4) Roles & owners + next steps (15m)

Success criteria we typically validate during the kickoff:
- End-to-end inference on representative dataset (latency within target)
- Integration with your infra (VPC/keys) and data flow validated
- Acceptance criteria for go/no-go (documented owners)

I’ve attached a brief POC requirements workbook for prep. Please also flag who from engineering, procurement, and security should join so we can add them to the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment: POC_Requirements.xlsx

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: proposed dates + success criteria

Thanks Marissa —

Quick update from our side: staffing and internal reviews mean morning slots are easier for our engineering and security teams. Procurement would like to do a quick terms review the week before the kickoff. High-level constraints:

- Engineering: Tue/Thu mornings PT preferable
- Security: prefers Sep 23 morning, but can be flexible
- Procurement (Priya Shah): available Sep 21 for a short procurement sync

Is Sep 24 at 09:00 PT possible for Redwood? That would let us do a short procurement sync on the 21st and a security tech sync on the 23rd if needed. Also can you confirm the precise list of success criteria and any pre-reqs for the tech sync?

Alex
Alex Torres
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
alex.torres@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: proposed dates + success criteria

Alex — perfect, Sep 24 at 09:00 PT works for us and aligns with your constraints. We’ll aim to run the following cadence:

- Mon Sep 21: Procurement sync (Priya + Marissa) — 30m to run through SOW/PO expectations
- Wed Sep 23: Technical pre-sync (engineers + security + Dylan/Dev) — 30–45m to validate infra and pre-reqs
- Thu Sep 24 09:00 PT: POC kickoff (60–75m)

Confirmed success criteria for the kickoff (we’ll include these in the invite):
- Seed dataset ingested and inference validated end-to-end
- Latency and throughput baseline captured for representative load
- Integration checklist marked complete (networking, keys, credential exchange)
- Owners and timeline for remediation identified

Pre-reqs for the technical pre-sync:
- Access to a test VM or sample dataset (S3 link or share)
- Network contact for VPC peering/firewall questions
- A security contact for brief questionnaire review

I’ll draft the calendar invites after Priya confirms procurement availability. I’ve attached the POC workbook again and the security questionnaire our team will reference.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: POC_Requirements.xlsx, security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: proposed dates + success criteria

Hi Marissa / Alex —

Procurement can do a quick sync on Mon Sep 21 at 11:00 PT to confirm PO process and high-level terms. For the kickoff itself, we’ll want to have a draft SOW or a simple one-page statement of work beforehand. Can you share an example SOW and an estimate for potential committed spend / monthly run rate for the POC (ballpark)? That will help expedite approvals.

If it helps, I’m happy to keep the procurement call to 20–30 minutes.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
priya.shah@acme.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme.com>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: proposed dates + success criteria

Alex / Michael —

I can run the technical pre-sync on Wed Sep 23. Suggest we make it a 30-minute session focused on:

- Network/topology review (VPC peering, egress rules)
- Data access (S3 buckets, credentials, sample dataset)
- Auth/KMS keys and how we’ll exchange secrets
- Basic perf expectations and what telemetry we’ll capture

Pre-sync checklist (short):
- Provide one sample dataset link or test VM
- Confirm a security contact for the questionnaire (Michael?)
- Share any internal IP allowlist requirements

Link to our tech checklist: https://drive.redwood.example.com/ACME/POC/tech-checklist

Attachment: redwood-tech-checklist.md

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@acme.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: proposed dates + success criteria

All —

Thanks everyone. Confirming:
- Mon Sep 21 11:00 PT: procurement sync (Priya + Marissa)
- Wed Sep 23 10:00 PT: tech pre-sync (engineering + security + Redwood SEs) — Dylan/Dev noted
- Thu Sep 24 09:00 PT: full POC kickoff (60–75m)

I’ll send calendar invites for the three sessions and include the attendee list. Priya — I’ll ask my procurement lead to draft a one-page SOW and share a ballpark cost estimate before Monday. Michael — can you be our security contact for the questionnaire?

Appreciate the coordination — looking forward to getting started.

—
Alex Torres
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
alex.torres@acme.com
